pitch_routes.route: Disney Terms of Use s.7.A (covers Disney, ABC, ESPN, FX, National Geographic and other Disney brands): 'Our long-standing company policy does not allow us to accept or consider unsolicited creative ideas.' Pitch via agent/attorney or an established production company with an existing relationship.

briefs.title: Hulu docs are 'entertainment forward' - pop-culture entry points, 7-10 original docs a year
briefs.summary: Belisa Balaban (then SVP unscripted series & documentaries, Hulu Originals) said Hulu docs lead with well-known pop-culture subjects as an entry point to untold stories, aiming for roughly 7-10 original documentaries a year.

briefs.title: Hulu first-look deal with Switchboard Magazine
briefs.summary: Hulu took first-look rights to develop documentary features, docuseries and unscripted projects from Switchboard's character-driven nonfiction journalism - signals appetite for reporting-led doc IP.

commissioners.name: Rob Mills
commissioners.title: EVP, Unscripted & Alternative Entertainment, Walt Disney Television
commissioners.remit: Leads Walt Disney Television Alternative; oversees development and production of alternative programming, specials and late-night for ABC Entertainment and Hulu Originals (unscripted remit for Hulu since 2021). Reality/entertainment-led rather than documentary.
commissioners.pitch_route: No unsolicited ideas accepted (Disney company policy); approach via agent/attorney or established production company.
commissioners.notes: Realscreen Summit 2026 bio lists The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives and The Kardashians among projects but gives no commission dates, so none listed as recent commissions.

commissioners.name: Jilly Pearce
commissioners.title: SVP, Unscripted Programming (ABC and Hulu), Walt Disney Television
commissioners.remit: Development and current unscripted programming across ABC and Hulu; reports to Rob Mills. Current slate cited includes Hulu's The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives and Devil in the Family: The Fall of Ruby Franke.
commissioners.pitch_route: No unsolicited ideas accepted (Disney company policy); approach via agent/attorney or established production company.
commissioners.notes: Appointment reported 23 Jun 2025 (over 12 months ago); no 2026 confirmation found. UK ex-Objective Media/OMG America and C4.

commissioners.name: Belisa Balaban
commissioners.title: SVP, Unscripted Series and Documentaries, Hulu Originals
commissioners.remit: Hulu original documentaries and unscripted series.
commissioners.pitch_route: No unsolicited ideas accepted (Disney company policy); approach via agent/attorney or established production company.
commissioners.notes: Latest evidence is an April 2024 interview; no 2025-26 source found confirming she still holds the role. Hulu documentary senior manager Kate Bustamante left in June 2026 (localpage.uk report), so the doc team may have changed - verify before use.
